components.css: .ds-genres{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}.ds-genre{font-family:"Segoe UI",Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer}.ds-genre input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-genre span{padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line,#354558);border-radius:5px;color:var(--muted,#abb7c5);font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;transition:background .15s ease-out,color .15s ease-out}.ds-genre:hover span{border-color:#728197;color:var(--text,#eeeade)}.ds-genre input:checked+span{background:var(--accent,#e8aa96);color:var(--accent-ink,#271e1d);border-color:var(--accent,#e8aa96)}.ds-genre.ds-excluded input:checked+span{background:#483a40;color:#f0bcba;border-color:#af7984}.ds-genre input:focus-visible+span{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#e8aa96);outline-offset:4px}.ds-genre input:disabled+span{opacity:.35}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-genre span{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-card{font-family:"Segoe UI",Tahoma,Arial,sans-serif;width:200px;min-width:0;color:var(--text,#eeeade)}.ds-card a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;display:block}.ds-poster{position:relative;aspect-ratio:2/3;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface-raised,#203143);border-radius:6px}.ds-poster svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;transition:filter .18s ease-out}.ds-card a:hover svg{filter:brightness(1.06)}.ds-card a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#e8aa96);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:6px}.ds-score{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;position:absolute;top:9px;inset-inline-start:9px;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:4px;background:#142434;color:var(--text,#eeeade);font-size:10px;font-weight:650;direction:ltr}.ds-star{color:#e8c988}.ds-open{position:absolute;inset-inline-end:9px;bottom:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:29px;height:29px;background:var(--background,#101c2b);border-radius:50%;font-size:17px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s ease-out}.ds-card a:hover .ds-open,.ds-card a:focus-visible .ds-open{opacity:1}.ds-card h3{font-size:12px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.6;margin:12px 0 4px}.ds-card a:hover h3{color:var(--accent,#e8aa96)}.ds-meta{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted,#abb7c5);line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 4px}.ds-card p:last-child{font-size:9px;color:var(--subtle,#96a7ba);line-height:1.75;margin:0}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-poster svg,.ds-open{transition:none}}

narrative.northStar: Turn constraints into a film choice.
narrative.overview:
A quiet cinematic interface gives preferences, film choices, and their evidence clear places to live. Ink navy and warm paper form the reading surface; muted coral marks actions and selection. Original geometric posters supply the strongest variation in color and composition.

Frame remains a reversible working name. This app-scoped record reflects the shared stylesheet, shell, discovery controls, film cards, and local poster generator. Accessible controls, readable evidence, and honest unknown states constrain future screens.
keyCharacteristics: Dark reading surfaces with warm text and restrained coral emphasis.
Flat tonal layers, thin dividers, and compact softened corners.
Original portrait artwork and controls that respect English LTR and Persian RTL.

rules.name: The Selection Coral Rule
rules.body: Use coral for actionable emphasis, included selection, and focus. Preserve a separate visible treatment for exclusions.

rules.name: The Script Room Rule
rules.body: Persian headings remove letter spacing and use expanded line height (1.6). Preserve automatic direction for mixed film titles and LTR direction for numeric ranges.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate interface regions with tone, thin borders, and space. Reserve bright compositional contrast for the artwork and meaningful control states.

dos: Do reserve portrait space for original geometric posters.
Do preserve visible labels, coral keyboard focus, and minimum hit heights.
Do use logical start/end spacing and script-specific heading treatment.
Do keep synthetic labels and unknown values visible alongside film information.
Do honor reduced motion by removing animation and transitions.
donts: Don't communicate inclusion or exclusion through color alone.
Don't place essential film information behind a hover-only affordance.
Don't replace uncertain film values with fabricated scores, dates, or runtimes.
Don't promote compact utility text into the default size for new prose.
